title: Moment two fighter jets collide mid-air at US air show
originalTitle: Moment two fighter jets collide mid-air at US air show
content:
Four crew members are in stable condition after two fighter jets collided mid-air during a US air show, officials have said.

The US Navy EA18-G jets were performing an aerial demonstration when they crashed, but all of those on board ejected safely.

The dramatic incident happened on Sunday, during the second and final day of the Gunfighter Skies air show in Idaho.
